design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. The member asks for one thing only: the figure that clears his propane account today. Nothing in what he says names the two entries the cooperative still owes the account before that figure can be right, and neither of them is a status flip: each is its own multi-factor computation over the same ledger. The agent has to read out of the desk manuals that the clearing figure waits on a protection credit and on a budget plan true-up, work both out from the ledger, book them, and only then work out what the member must send. Getting the tools right is trivial; getting the arithmetic right over a thirty-eight row ledger, a grain ledger in another division and four tier ladders per computation is the whole difficulty.

SCOPE. Task 0 claims energy_ext_protection_floor_credit, energy_ext_budget_year_reconciliation and energy_ext_account_clearance_payment with their three task tools, covering the subjects energy_price_protection_credited, energy_budget_installment_billed and energy_payment_posted. Nothing else is claimed. Task 1 is left the whole pre-buy and closure side of the charter: energy_contract_gallons_booked, energy_account_updated, energy_contract_gallons_drawn and energy_account_closed, which no policy here touches.

STEP 0 DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/tasks/energy_delivery_desk --task 0): {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 5]}. The tree therefore has exactly two prerequisite problems. The budget year reconciliation took the count of 6, the clearing payment took 4, the protection credit took 5.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root problem: energy_ext_account_clearance_payment (the figure the member asked for). Prerequisite problems: energy_ext_protection_floor_credit and energy_ext_budget_year_reconciliation, both prerequisites of the root, neither of the other.
 Edge root <- protection credit. kind value_input; gate credits_allowed (a compute binding of the root); form state; prerequisite sentence, quoted verbatim from the root's own rule: "The amount that clears the account is fixed only after the account carries, on every pre-buy booking whose protected floor stood above the posted price, a downside protection credit dated in the month the amount is worked out." Four-point test: (1) 'only after' joins the root's own result to what it waits on; (2) the thing waited on is a record-visible state, a protection credit entry dated in the current month standing on the account against a booking, named in the words the account activity uses; (3) no tool, no policy id, no code token; (4) the strength is hard ('only after') and the scope is exactly the bookings whose floor stood above the posted price with the period the credit must be dated in, which is word for word the edge's condition — the sentence carries the period itself, so it is not satisfied by the earlier credits of June and July. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: the protection credit policy is the only one whose result is a protection credit entry on the account, so the derivation runs sentence + the account activity showing the last protection credit dated 2026-07-31 + the protection policy's own rule (what it books) -> record the protection credit. Unmet at frozen_time: the booking EC-330742 still stands with 1300 gallons undrawn and the posted price of record has fallen under the protected floor, yet the most recent protection credit on the account is dated 2026-07-31. Resolved by record_price_protection_credit_43e8349b, owner agent.
 Edge root <- budget year reconciliation. kind value_input; gate instalments_billed; form state; prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the root's own rule: "Before the amount that clears the account is worked out, the account must carry the true-up entry owed for every budget plan year that has passed its reconciliation date." Four-point test: (1) 'Before' joins the root's result to what it waits on; (2) a record-visible state, a true-up entry among the instalments billed on the account; (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) hard ('must carry'), scoped exactly to plan years past their reconciliation date. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: the reconciliation policy is the only one whose result is an entry among the instalments billed. Unmet at frozen_time: the programme reconciles on 07-15 and the latest instalment entry on the account is the ordinary level instalment of 2026-06-01; no true-up entry stands. Resolved by bill_budget_plan_reconciliation_cfd56d13, owner agent.
 Topological order: protection credit, then reconciliation, then the clearing payment. The two prerequisites are parallel and commute: the reconciliation reads deliveries, drawdowns, fees, instalments, payments and the grain ledger and never protection credits, and the protection credit reads bookings, drawdowns, deliveries, protection credits and the grain ledger and never instalments or payments. Run both ways the figures are identical: the reconciliation evaluates to 719.61 on the opening world and to 719.61 after the protection credit has landed, and the protection credit evaluates to 188.97 either way.
 Per-edge deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping the protection credit moves the clearing payment from 3648.14 to 3842.83; skipping the reconciliation moves it from 3648.14 to 2906.74. Both edges bear weight.
 user_scenario mentions neither prerequisite: it names no protection credit, no floor, no budget true-up and no reconciliation, and asks for nothing beyond the figure that clears the account. The tool layer blocks nothing: post_energy_account_clearing_payment_6fe49ac6 writes the payment row it is given whatever else stands on the account, and neither of the other two tools reads or checks the other's work.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Subject energy_payment_posted is governed by energy_agg_across_accounts and energy_payments_and_arrears. energy_agg_across_accounts carries one eligibility, account_live_for_delivery, whose applies_to is energy_delivery_made alone, so for a payment it governs by scope only: the payment is applied to the account it was received on and is never spread across the member's other energy account. energy_payments_and_arrears carries one eligibility, late_charge_after_grace, whose condition is the whole sentence "An invoice still unpaid after the programme's grace period, counted in whole calendar days from the due date, carries the programme's late charge once and then the programme's monthly service charge for as long as it stands unpaid." This policy states its own basis for all three of those things — when the amount falls due, what late charge is added and at what rate the arrears bear — so that sentence is named in energy_ext_account_clearance_payment's overwrite and retired with it, and the gate goes with the sentence: energy_payments_and_arrears governs this write by scope alone (payment methods, oldest-invoice allocation, the past-due flag). The extended basis is checked at frozen_time in its place: the account was last paid 2026-06-12, the programme's terms are 15 calendar days and its grace 10, so the amount fell due 2026-06-27, passed grace on 2026-07-07, and stands 79 days overdue on 2026-09-14. Just-short case: had the last payment landed 2026-09-04, the days overdue would be nothing, no late charge and no service charge would enter the figure, and the member would owe the standing amount alone. At-boundary case: a last payment of 2026-08-20 puts the amount 10 days past its terms on 2026-09-14, exactly the grace period, and the charge is added only beyond it, so nothing is added on the handling date itself. Subject energy_price_protection_credited is governed by energy_price_protection alone, which carries no structured eligibility for it; subject energy_budget_installment_billed by energy_budget_plan alone, likewise.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The object is energy account EA-551204, the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy propane account serving the grain dryer, and within it the pre-buy booking EC-330742 and the plan year whose instalments run 2025-08 through 2026-06. The correlation key back to one stop is the delivery ticket, back to one booking the contract reference EC-330742, back to one invoice the invoice number. The member's other energy account, EA-551188, the will-call tank at the house, carries its own stop, its own handling charge and its own bank transfer of 507.50 USD: every aggregate in all three computations is scoped to the account being handled, so none of those three rows enters any figure, and contracted gallons booked on EA-551204 can never be drawn at EA-551188. The oldest energy invoice standing unpaid on EA-551204 is EI-440712 of 2025-11-12: the eight standing drafts each clear the instalment invoice they name, and the bank transfer of 2026-06-12 clears EI-440626, so no payment has ever been applied to the fuel invoices.

FACTOR CARD. energy_ext_protection_floor_credit (5 factors). undrawn_holdback_basis, method: the tank is on the automatic keep-full schedule and 6 stops stand in the last twelve months, so one scheduled fill is held back, 1000 gallons times 80 less the 44.0 percent gauge the driver took on arriving at the stop of 2026-09-02 before any fuel was pumped, that is 360.0 gallons; the computation document holds nothing back, giving 1300 undrawn gallons and a credit of 203.71 instead of 115.26. The gauge the tier means is the arrival reading and the rule says so in those words: the ledger carries two driver readings on every stop, and the after-pumping one would be the programme's fill-to percentage itself on any stop the automatic schedule made, leaving nothing held back for exactly the members the tier is written for. protected_floor_share, parameter, cross-difficulty into grain: three grain delivery rows over the last twelve months total 46,820.00 net bushels, above the 40,000 whole-farm threshold, and the booking's 2400 gallons clear the programme's 1000 gallon minimum, so the floor is 90 plus 3, that is 93 percent, giving 1.3857; the baseline 90 percent gives 1.3410 and a credit of 73.24. account_margin_relief, parameter: 2740.0 gallons taken in the last twelve months and 1100 gallons drawn against bookings, so the margin is 0.8000 less 0.0600; the baseline 0.8000 gives 58.86. rack_of_record_anchor, method: two will-call stops in the last three months, 1.2100 on 2026-07-08 and 1.1900 on 2026-09-02, so the rack is their average less the margin, 0.4000; the baseline, which is the ladder's own fall-through, takes the latest will-call stop alone, 0.3900, giving 124.66. The ladder divides members by how many will-call stops they have: two or more in the window are averaged, none at all with a booking standing falls back on the booked price, and one stop — the commonest case — is taken alone. What a will-call stop is, the rule now says in its own words rather than leaving it to the ledger's delivery type: one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking. Nothing in it turns on the programme's route frequency, which would have divided no member who can carry a protection credit at all. prior_protection_offset, parameter: two protection credits already stand in the window, 71.20 and 44.50, and 2400 gallons is twice the 1000 gallon minimum, so the whole 115.70 is set off; the baseline sets nothing off and gives 230.96. Every factor's tier rests on ledger rows, never on a stamp. Whole baseline: 196.30 against gold 115.26.
energy_ext_budget_year_reconciliation (6 factors). plan_year_window, method: the account has stood open since 2015-04-20 and no instalment was billed in the three months to 2026-09-14, so the plan year is counted over 13 months, taking in the instalment of 2025-09-01; the baseline 12 months drops it and gives 1116.16. drawdown_recognition, parameter: 2400 gallons booked and 1100 drawn, so the whole 1639.00 of drawdown money counts; the baseline counts none and gives -940.35. fee_recognition, parameter: the tank is the cooperative's and 2740.0 gallons clear the 400 gallon waiver, so none of the 140.00 of fees counts; the baseline counts all of it and gives 863.81. plan_collection_basis, method: 7 drafts in the window, short of 10, and one bank transfer posted on the account, so the collection is 2695.00 plus the 600.00 that transfer brought rather than the 3850.00 of instalments billed; the baseline gives 147.96. The ladder counts payments posted on the account, which keeps the money committed on the pre-buy booking - a ledger row that also carries a bank-transfer reference - out of the plan's collection. trueup_settlement_allowance, parameter, cross-difficulty into grain: two grain settlements of 44,120.75 and 40,185.30 net total 84,306.05, above the 25,000 cover, and the programme allows grain proceeds onto the energy account, so 120.00 comes off; the baseline gives 843.21. late_trueup_rate_relief, parameter: the last instalment was billed 3 whole months ago and the year's cost of 4113.65 is under the 10,000 ceiling, so the difference bears 1.50 less 0.50 percent a month; the baseline bears nothing and gives 698.65. Whole baseline: -850.35 against gold 719.61.
energy_ext_account_clearance_payment (4 factors). arrears_month_count_basis, method: 79 days overdue, beyond the 60 deep-arrears days, and three stops in the last three months, so the months are 79 over 30 carried to four places, 2.6333; the baseline counts 2 whole thirty-day months and gives 3697.44. secured_arrears_rate, parameter, cross-difficulty into grain: 84,306.05 of grain settlements over the cover and 1300 gallons still owed out of the pre-buy above the 1000 gallon minimum, so the rate is 1.50 less 0.35; the baseline 1.50 gives 3757.80. lapsed_plan_late_charge, parameter: 6 drafts in the last twelve months, at least the lapsed-plan count of 6 and under the full plan count of 11, so the charge is 30.00; the baseline is the programme's 15.00 and gives 3709.08. long_standing_settlement_allowance, parameter: the account has stood open 11.4 years and 2740.0 gallons clear the 2000 gallon loyalty mark, so 75.00 comes off; the baseline allows nothing and gives 3799.08. Whole baseline: 3783.05 against gold 3724.08.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS. The six stops carry the gauge readings the holdback factor reads, the will-call prices the rack anchor reads and the gallons three separate volume ladders read; delete the 2026-09-02 stop and the holdback, the rack and the late-charge window all move. The two drawdowns fix the gallons still undrawn and the drawdown money the true-up recognises. The eleven instalments and eight drafts are what the plan collection and the late-charge ladder are read off; delete two drafts and the late charge jumps from 30.00 to 45.00. The two protection credits are the prior offset. The seven fee rows are what the fee recognition ladder switches off. The grain contract and its five ledger rows are the cross-difficulty evidence for three separate factors. The house tank account and its three rows are the near-miss: a second energy account of the same member, with its own bank transfer, which every account-scoped aggregate must exclude. No cache trap is designed here: account_balance on EA-551204 is 3053.95, exactly the sum of the fuel receivable deltas at the opening, and the difficulty lies in what the account does not yet carry rather than in a stale figure. Base automatic clauses checked row by row: tank rent is 0.00 on this programme so no rent falls due on 2026-11-01; the seasonal hold is not open on this programme; the delivery hold at 45 days past due is a hold on fuel going out, not an obligation any task must discharge, and no delivery is written here.

PERSONA DESIGN. Marston is written as a blunt, unhurried operator who states his goal once and then waits. He volunteers only the surface goal, the fact that the drafts stopped in March when he changed banks, and his membership number, all of which the opening world supports. Identity credentials come out one at a time and only when asked. He refuses to guess the balance, which keeps the figure in the agent's hands. His authorisation is explicit in both directions: the agent may act for him on the account, but the money moves from his own bank, by his own hand, and he will not give card details or post a cheque. He says nothing about anything needing to be put in order, and names no item of work. The bank reference EP-118692 is his to state and is stated only when he actually makes the payment. His last reaction answers the last gold action and stops there.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION. Locate the member from the membership number he states; verify him on the membership number and the tax number; read the two energy accounts; read the whole energy ledger, which is where every aggregate in all three computations comes from; read the grain contract and the grain ledger, which is where three cross-difficulty ladders come from. The desk then books the protection credit and the true-up itself, and hands the payment to the member. Everything happens under one frozen_time; nothing waits on a truck, a bank clearing, a review or a future date. Questions a real agent would ask that never enter gold - which account, whether a part payment would do, how he wants to pay - all have definite answers in the persona.

WHAT IS EASILY GOT WRONG. Reading the balance off account_balance and quoting 3053.95; missing that the two owed entries have to be booked before the figure is right; letting the house tank's 507.50 bank transfer into the account's payments; counting the instalment of 2025-08-01 in the plan year, which sits 13 whole months back and falls outside even the widened window; taking the rack off the latest will-call stop rather than averaging the two in the window; counting the eight drafts as eight when only six fall inside the twelve months the late-charge ladder reads; and forgetting that the 115.70 already credited is set off against the new protection credit.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Read the ledger. Work the protection credit: 2400 booked less 1100 drawn less a 360.0 gallon holdback is 940.0 undrawn; the floor is 93 percent of 1.4900, that is 1.3857; the rack is the average of 1.2100 and 1.1900 less 0.8000, that is 0.4000, and the margin allowed is 0.7400, so the posted price is 1.1400 and the gap 0.2457; 940.0 times 0.2457 is 230.96 less the 115.70 already credited, giving 115.26. Work the true-up over 13 months: cost 2474.65 of fuel plus 1639.00 of drawdown money plus nothing of fees is 4113.65; the plan took 2695.00 of drafts plus 600.00 by transfer, that is 3295.00; less the 120.00 allowance the difference is 698.65, and three months at 1.00 percent adds 20.96, giving 719.61. Then the clearing figure: 2474.65 of fuel plus 140.00 of fees plus 4954.61 of instalments less 3680.00 of payments less 230.96 of credits is 3658.30 standing; 30.00 late charge; 3658.30 at 1.15 percent for 2.6333 months is 110.78; less the 75.00 allowance the member sends 3724.08.

VERIFICATION RUN. The formulas were reproduced binding by binding on the handling-time worlds with the gate's own restricted evaluator (skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py build_env/eval_compute), each computation evaluated on initial_state plus the gold writes that precede it. Output: protection credit 115.26 (whole baseline 196.30; per-factor baselines 203.71, 73.24, 58.86, 124.66, 230.96); reconciliation 719.61 (whole baseline -850.35; per-factor baselines 1116.16, -940.35, 863.81, 147.96, 843.21, 698.65); clearing payment 3724.08 (whole baseline 3783.05; per-factor baselines 3697.44, 3757.80, 3709.08, 3799.08). Prerequisite sensitivity: without the protection credit the payment is 3842.83, without the reconciliation 2982.68. Order sensitivity: the reconciliation gives 719.61 whether or not the protection credit has landed, and the protection credit gives 115.26 either way, so the two parallel prerequisites commute.

CLOSURE. energy_ext_protection_floor_credit -> record_price_protection_credit_43e8349b -> computations[0] -> action 7 -> a protection credit line of -115.26 on EA-551204. energy_ext_budget_year_reconciliation -> bill_budget_plan_reconciliation_cfd56d13 -> computations[1] -> action 9 -> a true-up line of 719.61. energy_ext_account_clearance_payment -> post_energy_account_clearing_payment_6fe49ac6 -> computations[2] -> action 11 -> a payment line of -3724.08. charter_scope, required_documents and the computation policy ids are the same three ids in the same order, and the write order is the topological order of the tree. The pre-write eligibility evidence in solvability_contract is the account row and the invoice row EI-440712 for the two scope entries; with the arrears sentence retired by declared override there is no time gate on any of the three writes, so temporal_feasibility is empty. The four declared overrides this task rests on are: energy_pricing's posted-price sentence, superseded by the protection policy's own posted price of the rack of record plus the margin allowed on the account; energy_price_protection's floor sentence; energy_payments_and_arrears' due-date sentence; and energy_payments_and_arrears' grace/late-charge/service-charge sentence, superseded by the clearance policy's own service charge and late charge. Base's parameter values (late_fee_usd 15.00, finance_charge_monthly_pct 1.50, posted_price_margin_per_gallon_usd 0.8000) remain valid and base-homed and are exactly what each ladder's fall-through selects.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Masking the charter, compute, expected and gold, and working only from what the published manuals will say, the tool schemas, the rows the finders return and what Marston actually says: the manual for the clearing figure states outright that it is fixed only after the account carries, on a booking whose floor stood above the posted price, a protection credit dated in the month the amount is worked out, and that it must carry the true-up entry for a plan year past its reconciliation date. The account activity shows the last protection credit dated 2026-07-31 against a handling month of September 2026, and the last instalment dated 2026-06-01, so neither holds. Working the two documents' own figures gives 115.26 and 719.61, and the clearing figure then gives 3724.08, the same three numbers and the same order as gold, with no second reading available: the member names no invoice of his own, and the payment tool's contract says the money goes to the earliest-dated energy invoice standing unpaid, which on this account is EI-440712 of 2025-11-12 — the rival reading by invoice number, EI-440629, is shut out by that word.

REVISION 2 (source-layer policy-task audit, round 2). Symptoms, causes, changes and re-runs, keyed to the audit's item ids. F1: the protection policy varied the programme's posted-price margin while base energy_pricing fixed it, and energy_pricing was not even in its lineage; cause, an undeclared override; change, energy_pricing added to base_policy_refs and its posted-price sentence named in overwrite against this policy's own "The posted price is the rack of record plus the margin allowed on the account, taken to four decimal places."; re-run, all figures unchanged (188.97 / 719.61 / 3648.14) because the ladders themselves did not move. F2 and F3: the late charge and the arrears rate were both taken from ladders while base energy_payments_and_arrears fixed both in one sentence; cause, that sentence was not named in overwrite; change, it is now named, with this policy's own service-charge and late-charge sentences as replaced_by. Because the retired sentence is also the late_charge_after_grace gate's condition, that gate is retired with it: solvability_contract now carries energy_payments_and_arrears as a scope entry and temporal_feasibility is empty. No scored value moved. F6: rack_of_record_anchor conditioned on the programme's route frequency, which holds of every programme that can carry a protection credit, and its third tier named a route no such programme has, so the ladder was two real tiers and its baseline was drawn from an unreachable tier; cause, a conjunct that restates the policy's scope; change, the route conjunct is gone and the ladder now divides on the count of called-in stops alone — two or more, none at all with a booking standing, and everything else — so all three tiers are reachable and the fall-through is the common case the baseline states; re-run, the world still takes tier 1, rack 0.4000, credit 188.97, and the factor's baseline is still 0.3900 giving 201.37, all unchanged. O1: the third tier of account_margin_relief, prior_protection_offset, rack_of_record_anchor and lapsed_plan_late_charge is now written as the residual ("In every other case ..."), so the stated ladder exhausts the space its compute branch covers; no world lands differently and no figure moved. O3: the edge's condition carried "for the period being measured" while its sentence did not, so the sentence alone would have been satisfied by the June and July credits; change, the sentence now reads "... a downside protection credit dated in the month the amount is worked out", and the condition and the why_false follow it word for word. O7: the persona's authorisation no longer says the desk may "put the account in order first" — it authorises the agent to act on the account and names nothing to be put right. O8: "oldest invoice" was undefined between date and number and the two readings differ here; change, the payment tool's contract now says earliest-dated, in the capability line and in the argument, and the tracing quotes it and shuts out EI-440629 by name. Every per-task and difficulty-wide gate was re-run after these changes and is green; the recomputation of all three computations, all fifteen factor sensitivities and both edge-skip figures was byte-identical to revision 1 at that round; revision 3 below moves two of the three scored figures.

REVISION 3 (render-layer audit, round 3). P1, the one KB-RUNTIME RED. Symptom: a reader working from the published documents and the records took the hold-back tier's "the gauge reading the driver recorded at the most recent stop" as the arrival reading (44.0) and reached a protection credit of 115.26 on 940.0 gallons and a clearing payment of 3724.08, while the compute binding took the after-pumping reading (74.0) and scored 188.97 on 1240.0 gallons and 3648.14. Cause: the ledger records two driver gauge readings on every stop and the rule sentence named neither, so only the un-renderable binding chose between them; the published document carried the sentence word for word, which is why the defect is the rule's and not the render's. Change, and which way: the business meaning settles it against the binding, not for it. The tier holds back what the next automatic fill will take, and a keep-full fill runs from where the truck finds the tank up to the programme's fill-to percentage — so the reading that measures it is the arrival gauge. The after-pumping reading is the fill-to percentage itself on any stop the automatic schedule made, which would leave nothing held back for exactly the members the tier is written for, and on this world it gave a figure at all only because the most recent stop happened to be a will-call fill that stopped short of the fill-to. So the compute moved to the arrival reading and the sentence was sharpened to name it: "less the gauge reading the driver took on arriving at the most recent stop, before any fuel was pumped". The binding is renamed last_gauge_before and reads tank_percent_before. Figures re-derived on the same seed: holdback 360.0 instead of 60.0, gallons still undrawn 940.0 instead of 1240.0, protection_credit_usd 115.26 instead of 188.97, credits allowed -230.96 instead of -304.67, amount standing 3658.30 instead of 3584.59, service charge 110.78 instead of 108.55, payment_amount_usd 3724.08 instead of 3648.14. The true-up is untouched at 719.61, since it reads no protection credit. Every factor still bears weight (203.71, 73.24, 58.86, 124.66, 230.96 against 115.26; 3697.44, 3757.80, 3709.08, 3799.08 against 3724.08), both whole baselines still differ from gold (196.30 and 3783.05), both edges still bear weight (3842.83 and 2982.68), and the two parallel prerequisites still commute. P3: "stops the member called in" was bound to the will-call delivery type by the compute alone, so an after-hours stop was silently not one; the rules now say "will-call stops" and each of the four policies that use the term defines it once in its own words. On this task the rack ladder's count is unchanged at two (both stops in the window are will-call), so no figure moved; the tier wording in factor_sensitivity follows the ladder. P2 belongs to the closure policy, which this task does not claim. D2 is a document-side note for the re-render. Every per-task and difficulty-wide gate was re-run after these changes and is green.
user_scenario:
Marston Ostlund farms about twenty-six hundred acres of corn and beans out of Garner with his brother, and he is calling the member services desk from the shop with the radio going in the background. He is a blunt, unhurried man who says what he wants once and then waits for an answer. What he wants is simple: the propane account for the grain dryer has got away from him since the bank drafts stopped in the spring, and he wants to pay it off today, in full, before the corn comes off and he needs the tank filled again. He will say, without being pushed, that the drafts quit when he moved the farm accounts to a different bank in March and he never got round to setting them up again, and that he would rather clear the whole thing in one go than dribble at it.

He offers his membership number, M-55012, early on, because the statement is lying on the bench in front of him. If the agent asks for something more to prove who he is, he reads off the last four digits of the farm's tax number, 5512, and if pressed for a third thing he gives the mobile the cooperative has on file, 5150550142. He knows none of the cooperative's internal reference numbers and says so cheerfully. If the agent asks which account he means, he says it is the big tank at the dryer and not the little one up at the house, and that the dryer tank is the one he pre-buys gallons on every spring.

He does not know what the balance is and will not guess at it. Asked, he says the last statement he actually opened was months ago and he would rather the agent read the figure off the books than have him misquote it. He is not after a payment arrangement and not after a part payment: he wants the one figure that clears the account outright, today, and he will say so plainly if the agent offers him anything less than that. He is content for the agent to act for him on the account, and says as much if the agent asks whether it is all right to work on it, though he would rather be given one figure at the end than a running commentary.

The money he will move himself, from the farm's own bank account, as a transfer. He will not read card numbers down a telephone and he is not going to put a cheque in the post, and he says so if either is suggested. When the agent has the figure worked out and hands the payment over for him to make, he makes it there and then, and he reads back the reference his bank has put on it, EP-118692. Once he hears that the payment is on the account he says that is one less thing before harvest, thanks the agent and rings off. If the agent quotes him a figure without ever putting anything through, he just waits to be told how to send it.

request_alignment.claim: The member wants the one figure that settles his dryer propane account outright today, and wants to send that money himself.
evidence: user_scenario:he wants the one figure that clears the account outright, today
user_scenario:The money he will move himself, from the farm's own bank account, as a transfer.

gold_actions.business_effect: A downside protection credit of 115.26 USD is booked against booking EC-330742 on account EA-551204 and comes off what the member owes.

request_binding.action_semantics: The protection sold with booking EC-330742 has fallen due for the period just closed: the posted price of record for propane on the account stands under the protected floor while gallons remain undrawn, and the account carries no credit for it. That is a credit the cooperative owes whether or not anyone calls, and it is the only class of write that puts a protection credit on a booking.

stage_provenance.fact: The credit is worked out and booked on the spot from the booking, the drawdowns and the prices already on the ledger; nothing outside the records has to happen first.

base_preconditions.condition: Downside protection is sold with a pre-buy booking on programmes that carry it, the credit attaches to the booking it was sold with and is applied to the account rather than paid out, and protection ends when the booking is exhausted, when the gallons expire or when the booking is cancelled.

Trueing the plan up is money the books owe either way, and billing a true-up among the instalments is the only class of write that settles it.

stage_provenance.fact: The true-up is worked out and billed on the spot from the instalments, drafts, fuel and fees already on the ledger; no back-office run and no future date is waited on.

base_preconditions.condition: A level payment plan spreads an estimated year of fuel over equal monthly instalments, the plan year begins on the programme's start date, runs for the programme's number of months and is trued up on the programme's reconciliation date.

base_preconditions.condition: A payment that names no invoice is applied to the account it was received on, oldest invoice first, and is never spread across accounts; contracted gallons are tied to the account and the fuel they were booked on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the membership profile from the number the caller reads off his statement, so the desk knows whose energy account is being discussed and holds his internal member reference.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later lookup and every write is keyed to the member's internal reference, which only this profile lookup returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Check the two details the caller states against the membership profile and record that identity cleared on this call.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account may be read or written until identity clears; the membership number and the last four of the tax number are the two details he offers.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List both energy accounts the member holds, with the programme, the tank, the route, the contracted gallons and price, the keep-full enrolment, the gallons still owed and the balance carried.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier, the tank capacity, the contracted price, the keep-full enrolment, the gallons still owed and the account opening date feed the holdback, floor, margin, drawdown, fee, rate and allowance ladders, and the second account is what every account-scoped aggregate has to be kept clear of.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole energy ledger for the member: the pre-buy booking, both drawdowns, the six stops with their gauge readings and prices, the seven fee lines, the eleven level instalments, the nine payments and the two protection credits already allowed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every history aggregate in all three computations is taken off these rows, and they are also where the agent sees that the last protection credit is dated 2026-07-31 and the last instalment 2026-06-01, which is how both prerequisites are found to be unmet.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Find the member's grain marketing contract, so the grain ledger rows read next can be tied to a contract of his own.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The cross-difficulty ladders read the member's grain business; without the contract the grain ledger rows cannot be attributed to him.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the grain ledger: the three loads applied over the last twelve months and the two settlement statements issued on them.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The net bushels decide the protected floor tier, and the net settlement amounts decide both the true-up allowance tier and the rate the arrears bear.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's protection credit tool named by the protection policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair; it changes nothing in the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Credit the downside protection owed on booking EC-330742 to account EA-551204, lowering what the member owes by that credit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: energy_ext_protection_floor_credit is the only policy that computes protection_credit_usd, and its result is what the account has to carry before the clearing figure can be worked out.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_account_id: The internal reference of energy account EA-551204. Basis: the member says it is "the big tank at the dryer and not the little one up at the house, and that the dryer tank is the one he pre-buys gallons on every spring", and the account lookup returns exactly one account of his carrying contracted gallons and a contracted price, EA-551204. Uniqueness: the other account, EA-551188, carries no contracted gallons and no booking, so downside protection, which is sold only with a pre-buy booking, cannot attach to it.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.contract_reference: EC-330742. Basis: the protection rule states that "Downside protection credited on a pre-buy booking is worked out on the gallons the member has booked and not yet drawn on the account", and the ledger carries exactly one booking line on this account, contract reference EC-330742 of 2026-05-18 for 2400 gallons. Uniqueness: no other booking reference appears anywhere in the member's energy activity, and both drawdowns and both earlier protection credits already name this one.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.gallons: 940.0. Basis: the tool's own contract asks for the gallons the credit was measured on, and the rule fixes them as the gallons still undrawn: "The gallons still undrawn are the gallons booked on the account less the gallons already drawn against those bookings", less the holdback the keep-full ladder imposes, which is "the programme's fill-to percentage of the tank's water capacity less the gauge reading the driver took on arriving at the most recent stop, before any fuel was pumped, taken on that capacity and rounded to one decimal place". Uniqueness: 2400.0 booked less 620.0 and 480.0 drawn is 1300.0, and the tank being on the automatic schedule with six stops in the last twelve months holds back 1000 times 80 less the arrival gauge of the stop of 2026-09-02, which the ledger records as 44.0 percent before pumping, that is 360.0 gallons, leaving 940.0. The after-pumping reading of 74.0 on the same row is not the one the sentence names, and on a stop the automatic schedule made it would be the fill-to percentage itself, leaving nothing held back at all.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.posted_price_per_gallon: 1.1400. Basis: the rule fixes the posted price as "the rack of record plus the margin allowed on the account, taken to four decimal places". Uniqueness: two will-call stops fall in the three months to 2026-09-14, at 1.2100 and 1.1900, and the tank sits on a route run every 21 days, so the rack is their average less the programme's 0.8000 margin, that is 0.4000; the margin allowed is 0.8000 less the 0.0600 high-volume relief, since 2740.0 gallons were taken in the last twelve months and 1100 gallons drawn against bookings; 0.4000 plus 0.7400 is 1.1400.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.protection_credit_usd: 115.26, the figure energy_ext_protection_floor_credit computes. The protected floor is 93 percent of the 1.4900 booked price, that is 1.3857, because the member's grain deliveries over the last twelve months total 46,820.00 net bushels, above the 40,000 whole-farm threshold, and the booking's 2400 gallons clear the programme's 1000 gallon minimum. The posted price is 1.1400, so the gap is 0.2457 a gallon. The gallons still undrawn are 940.0 after the 360.0 gallon holdback. 940.0 times 0.2457 is 230.96. Two protection credits already stand in the window, 71.20 and 44.50, and 2400 gallons is twice the programme's minimum, so the whole 115.70 is set off, giving 115.26. Any agent who reads the same rows converges on the same number.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's budget plan true-up tool named by the reconciliation policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair; it changes nothing in the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Bill the budget plan true-up for the closed plan year onto account EA-551204, so the instalments billed carry what the plan year actually came to.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: energy_ext_budget_year_reconciliation is the only policy that computes reconciliation_amount_usd, and its entry is what the account has to carry before the clearing figure can be worked out.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_account_id: The internal reference of energy account EA-551204. Basis: the account lookup returns a level monthly instalment of 385.00 on EA-551204 and 0.00 on EA-551188, and the reconciliation rule opens "A budget plan is trued up by setting the cost the member ran up over the plan year against the collection the plan took over that year". Uniqueness: only one of the member's two energy accounts is on a budget plan at all, so there is no second candidate.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.reconciliation_amount_usd: 719.61, the figure energy_ext_budget_year_reconciliation computes. The account has stood open since 2015-04-20 and no instalment was billed in the three months to 2026-09-14, so the plan year is counted over 13 months. Over that window the fuel billed is 2474.65, the money applied against bookings is 1639.00 and is recognised in full because 2400 gallons were booked and 1100 drawn, and the 140.00 of fees is not recognised because the tank is the cooperative's and 2740.0 gallons clear the 400 gallon waiver: the year's cost is 4113.65. Seven drafts, short of ten, and one bank transfer make the plan's collection 2695.00 plus 600.00, that is 3295.00. The member's two grain settlements net 84,306.05, above the 25,000 cover, and the programme allows grain proceeds onto the energy account, so 120.00 comes off: the difference is 698.65. The last instalment was billed three whole months ago and the year's cost is under the 10,000 ceiling, so the difference bears 1.00 percent a month for three months, 20.96, giving 719.61.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's own payment tool and hand it over, so he can move the money from his own bank.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The clearing payment is the member's own act over his own money; the agent unlocks it at this point in the order and the member runs it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Post the member's own bank transfer against the oldest energy invoice standing unpaid on EA-551204, clearing the account outright.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: energy_ext_account_clearance_payment is the only policy that computes payment_amount_usd, and this is the write the member actually asked for.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_account_id: The internal reference of energy account EA-551204. Basis: the member asks to pay off "the propane account for the grain dryer" and identifies it as "the big tank at the dryer and not the little one up at the house"; the account lookup returns EA-551204 as the dryer account. Uniqueness: EA-551188 stands at a balance of 0.00 with nothing to clear, so it cannot be the account he is settling.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.invoice_number: EI-440712. Basis: the payment tool's own contract states the money is "applied to the earliest-dated energy invoice standing unpaid on it", and names the argument as "the one standing unpaid on the account with the earliest date on it", so the convention is by date and not by invoice number. Uniqueness: on EA-551204 the eight standing drafts each clear the instalment invoice they name and the bank transfer of 2026-06-12 clears EI-440626, so every fuel invoice is untouched; the earliest-dated of those is EI-440712, billed on the stop of 2025-11-12. No invoice on the account carries an earlier date, and the rival reading by invoice number, EI-440629 of 2026-05-01, is excluded by the contract's own words.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_reference: EP-118692. Basis: the member states it himself when he makes the payment - "he reads back the reference his bank has put on it, EP-118692". Uniqueness: it is his own remittance reference, stated verbatim, and no other reference in the records has that form and that owner.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_method: ach. Basis: the member says "The money he will move himself, from the farm's own bank account, as a transfer", and the tool's contract defines ach as where "you send the money as a bank transfer from your own bank". Uniqueness: check is out because "he is not going to put a cheque in the post"; credit_card is out because "He will not read card numbers down a telephone"; budget_draft is out because the standing draft is exactly what stopped in March and this is a payment he is making himself; grain_settlement_transfer is out because no grain settlement is outstanding - both settlements on the ledger were paid to him in December and February.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_amount_usd: 3724.08, the figure energy_ext_account_clearance_payment computes on the account as it stands once both owed entries are on it. The amount standing is 2474.65 of fuel plus 140.00 of fees plus 4954.61 of instalments, which is the 4235.00 of level instalments and the 719.61 true-up, less 3680.00 of payments and 230.96 of credits, which is the 115.70 already allowed and the 115.26 just credited: 3658.30. The last payment posted is 2026-06-12, so with 15 day terms the account is 79 days overdue; with three stops in the last three months the months charged are 79 over 30, that is 2.6333. The rate is 1.50 less 0.35 because the member's grain settlements of 84,306.05 clear the 25,000 cover and 1300 gallons are still owed out of the pre-buy: 1.15 percent a month, giving 110.78. Six drafts in the last twelve months put the late charge at 30.00, and the account having stood open 11.4 years with 2740.0 gallons taken allows 75.00 off. 3658.30 plus 30.00 plus 110.78 less 75.00 is 3724.08.

factor_trace: undrawn_holdback_basis (method): stops_12m counts 6 delivery rows on EA-551204 in the twelve months to 2026-09-14 and last_gauge_before reads 44.0, the gauge the driver took on arriving at the stop of 2026-09-02 before any fuel was pumped, so with keep_full_enrolled true the first tier applies and holdback_gallons is 1000 times (80.0 less 44.0) over 100, that is 360.0; the computation document holds nothing back, which would give 203.71.

protected_floor_share (parameter, cross-difficulty into grain): grain_bushels_12m sums the three grain_delivery_applied rows of 2025-10-14, 2025-11-03 and 2025-11-21 to 46,820.00 net bushels, above the 40,000 threshold, and booked_gallons is 2400.0, above the programme's 1000 gallon minimum, so the first tier gives floor_pct 93.0; the computation document's default 90.0 would give 73.24.

account_margin_relief (parameter): gallons_12m sums the six stops to 2740.0, above the 1800 high-volume mark, and drawn_gallons is 1100.0, above the 1000 gallon drawdown mark, so posted_margin is 0.8000 less 0.0600, that is 0.7400; the default 0.8000 would give 58.86.

rack_of_record_anchor (method): will_call_stops_3m counts the will-call stops of 2026-07-08 and 2026-09-02, will_call_price_sum_3m is 1.2100 plus 1.1900, and two or more will-call stops fall in the window, so rack_of_record is 1.2000 less 0.8000, that is 0.4000; the standard method, which is the ladder's fall-through, takes the latest such stop alone, 1.1900 less 0.8000, which would give 124.66.

prior_protection_offset (parameter): prior_credit_count finds the credits of 2026-06-30 and 2026-07-31 and prior_credits_year sums them to 115.70, and booked_gallons of 2400.0 is twice the 1000 gallon minimum, so prior_offset_usd is the whole 115.70; the computation document sets nothing off, which would give 230.96.

Bindings belonging to no factor: booked_gallons 2400.0 and drawn_gallons 1100.0 are plain aggregates over the booking and drawdown rows; undrawn_gallons 940.0, floor_price 1.3857, posted_price 1.1400, credit_per_gallon 0.2457 and result 115.26 are arithmetic over the factor outputs.

factor_trace: plan_year_window (method): account_years_c is 11.41 from the opening date of 2015-04-20, past the 3 settled-member years, and instalments_3m is 0 because the last instalment was billed 2026-06-01, three whole months back, so window_months is 13; the computation document counts 12 months, which drops the instalment of 2025-09-01 and would give 1116.16.

drawdown_recognition (parameter): booked_gallons_c is 2400.0, above the programme's 1000 gallon minimum, and drawn_gallons_c is 1100.0, above the 1000 gallon recognition mark, so drawdown_share is 1.0 and the whole 1639.00 of drawdown money enters the year's cost; the default recognises none of it and would give -940.35.

edges.condition: Every pre-buy booking on the account whose protected floor stands above the posted price carries a downside protection credit entry dated in the month the amount that clears the account is worked out.
edges.policy_source: The amount that clears the account is fixed only after the account carries, on every pre-buy booking whose protected floor stood above the posted price, a downside protection credit dated in the month the amount is worked out.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Booking EC-330742 still stands with 1300 gallons undrawn and the posted price of record for propane on the account, 1.1400, sits under the protected floor of 1.3857, so a credit is owed on it. The most recent protection credit standing on the account is dated 2026-07-31, and the amount that clears the account is worked out in September 2026, so no credit dated in that month stands on the booking and the account does not carry what the clearing figure waits on.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Recording the protection credit puts a credit of -115.26 on the account dated 2026-09-14, which is in the month the amount is worked out, so credits_allowed moves from -115.70 to -230.96 and the account carries the credit owed on the booking.

edges.condition: Every budget plan year whose reconciliation date has passed carries a true-up entry among the instalments billed on the account.
edges.policy_source: Before the amount that clears the account is worked out, the account must carry the true-up entry owed for every budget plan year that has passed its reconciliation date.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The programme trues its plan up on 07-15 and that date has passed, but the latest entry among the instalments billed on the account is the ordinary level instalment of 385.00 for plan month 2026-06, billed on 2026-06-01. No true-up entry stands on the account for the plan year just closed.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Billing the true-up puts an entry of 719.61 among the instalments dated 2026-09-14, so instalments_billed moves from 4235.00 to 4954.61 and the account carries the true-up owed for that plan year.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and commute, proved by running both orders on the gate's own evaluator: the reconciliation evaluates to 719.61 on the opening world and to 719.61 again on the world after the protection credit has landed, and the protection credit evaluates to 115.26 on the opening world and to 115.26 again after the true-up has landed. Neither reads what the other writes - the reconciliation's aggregates are over deliveries, drawdowns, fees, instalments, drafts and transfers, and the protection credit's are over bookings, drawdowns, deliveries and protection credits - and both write a fresh row under a content-hashed id, so either order leaves the identical terminal state and the identical clearing figure of 3724.08.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the protection credit and replaying everything else leaves credits_allowed at -115.70, so amount_standing rises to 3773.56 and the scored payment_amount_usd moves from 3724.08 to 3842.83.
Skipping the true-up and replaying everything else leaves instalments_billed at 4235.00, so amount_standing falls to 2938.69 and the scored payment_amount_usd moves from 3724.08 to 2982.68.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names neither prerequisite problem nor anything either of them resolves. It contains no protection credit, no protected floor, no posted price, no budget true-up, no reconciliation and no instalment arithmetic, and no line of the kind 'is there something else outstanding first'. Marston says only that the drafts stopped in March when he changed banks, which is an opening fact the ledger carries, and asks for the figure that clears the account. Everything he contributes to either prerequisite is a passive reaction after the agent has spoken: he agrees the desk may put the account in order, and he runs the payment when it is handed to him.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: No tool validates a prerequisite. post_energy_account_clearing_payment_6fe49ac6 reads the account only to copy the member reference onto the row and then calls ctx.create with the arguments it was given; it never counts credits, never looks for a true-up entry, never compares the figure with the ledger and returns the same confirmation whether or not the two owed entries stand. record_price_protection_credit_43e8349b and bill_budget_plan_reconciliation_cfd56d13 are the same shape: one ctx.create each, no branch on any other row. An agent who skips a prerequisite is answered normally and differs from gold only in the terminal hash.
